chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Salih ibn Aqabah, from Abi Kahmas, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):
Teach me a supplication by which I may expedite the provision (sustenance). He said to me: Shave your moustache and cut your nails, and let that be done on Friday.

key_terms.أَسْتَنْزِلُ: I expedite/descend (in the sense of bringing down or hastening)

ai.seo_question: What supplication and action does the Imam recommend for increasing sustenance on Friday?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) connects the spiritual act of supplication for sustenance with the physical purification of the body, specifically grooming the moustache and cutting nails on Fridays. This practice highlights the Shia emphasis on integrating *adab* (etiquette) and physical cleanliness with spiritual devotion, viewing Friday as a blessed time for both inner and outer purification to attract divine bounty.
